summary: Operational hardening plan for /usr/local/bin/start-expo.sh, the wrapper consumed by supervisor to start Metro/Expo on port 3000. The script has historically disappeared across container resets, causing 'Expo offline' incidents. This plan documents the current implementation, recovery steps, audit checks, and future mitigations.
impact: Expo preview returns 502 / connection refused; in-flight Metro hot-reload stops; frontend QR code unusable. Backend unaffected.
recovery_steps_when_missing: 1. Verify with `ls -la /usr/local/bin/start-expo.sh`. If absent, expo will stop.
2. Recreate the file with the exact 11 lines above (idempotent).
5. `sudo supervisorctl start expo` (or restart if running).

audit_checks.description: Contains pkill expo start and pkill metro
Uses `exec npx expo start` for proper PID semantics
[program:expo] in supervisor config points to wrapper

future_mitigations: Persist a copy of the wrapper under /app/ops/start-expo.sh and make supervisor block reference it directly (after operator approval).
Add a healthcheck endpoint /api/_ops/expo-health that returns 503 if Metro is unreachable; alarm on this.
Document the wrapper recovery in /app/docs/ops/EXPO_WRAPPER_RECOVERY.md (created here).
Optional: switch [program:expo] to use a Python supervisor child that re-creates the wrapper file on start if absent.
